title: RFC: Export Redwood Private audit logs to customer-owned object storage
author: Connor OBrien
release_notes: RFC only; no runtime behavior change.
description:
Context: multiple Redwood Private design partners are blocked on exporting audit logs into their own storage accounts for retention + SIEM ingestion. This PR adds an RFC doc and a prototype sink interface (no production deployment changes yet).

Proposal
- Add a pluggable Sink interface (S3Sink, GCSSink) with shared batching/compression behavior
- Standardize event format as JSONL and object naming scheme `redwood-audit/v1/tenant_id=.../cluster_id=.../date=.../part-xxxxx.jsonl.gz`
- Auth: AWS AssumeRole via IRSA + ExternalId required; GCP Workload Identity Federation (no static keys)
- Delivery: at-least-once, with local disk buffering and backpressure

Out of scope
- Azure Blob
- Hosted API / Dedicated usage

Notes
- Security requirements draft referenced in Confluence (to be finalized by Security)
- Support-driven intake tracked via INT-883

Checklist
- [x] RFC text reviewed by Private Deployments
- [x] Security review on auth model
- [ ] Product sign-off on supported sinks list

Commits
- add sink interface + noop sink
- add rfc doc w/ partitioning + schema

Changed areas
- pkg/sink/sink.go
- pkg/sink/s3.go (prototype)
- pkg/sink/gcs.go (prototype)
- docs/rfc/private-audit-log-export.md

Review conversation
Diego Fernandez: Please align the object naming with the installer values schema we already use in Private. Also call out NATS JetStream as the source in Private.
Connor OBrien: Updated RFC to reference JetStream and kept the naming scheme stable.

Aisha Rahman: ExternalId MUST be required for AssumeRole. Also we should say encryption at rest is required (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS).
Connor OBrien: Added ExternalId requirement and an encryption section.

Dev Patel: Prototype GCS auth in this PR is vague; can we link to the WIF docs we plan to use?
Connor OBrien: Added links in the RFC doc and a TODO for implementation details.

Outcome
Closed (RFC accepted; implementation will happen in follow-up PRs). Closed in favor of implementation PR #157.
